llm_condensed_answer:
SUMMARY: The Host interface needs a new method GetExtension(id ID) (Component, bool) to allow direct lookup of extensions by ID instead of iterating through all extensions. This change will be implemented in the core collector and Jaeger extensions, requiring updates to the interface definition, its implementations, and test mocks.

FILES:
- opentelemetry-collector/component/host.go — Primary interface definition that must be extended with the new method
- opentelemetry-collector/service/internal/graph/host.go — Actual Host implementation that must implement the new method
- opentelemetry-collector/component/componenttest/nop_host.go — Test mock implementation that must be updated
- jaeger/cmd/jaeger/internal/extension/jaegerquery/extension.go — Example extension using Host that should be updated to use the new method
- opentelemetry-collector/component/component.go — Defines Component interface used in the new method signature
- opentelemetry-collector/component/identifiable.go — Defines ID type used as parameter in the new method
